content: Write a practical memo of about 350 words for a small bakery deciding whether to introduce online preorders. The shop sells bread and pastries, has one oven, and currently records orders in a paper notebook. Morning queues are long, but unsold items accumulate on rainy afternoons. Two employees share the counter and packaging work. The owner can spend at most two hours each week maintaining an online menu. Propose a limited trial, explain how to avoid selling the same loaf twice, address missed pickups and refunds, and identify observations that would justify expanding or stopping the trial. Separate known facts from assumptions, and do not invent revenue or customer statistics.
